t: A low-cost FPGA board you program by dragging a file onto a USB drive.
steps: Buy the iCESugar from MuseLab on Tindie or AliExpress. The Tindie price is about 32 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the open FPGA tools Yosys, nextpnr, and IceStorm.
Download the iCESugar repo and read the English README.
Build the LED blink example from the repo.
Drag the finished file onto the iCELink USB drive and watch the LED.
Try the open FPGA Verilog tutorial that MuseLab recommends.
meta: Open Board. From $32. A few stores.
